city_tips.title: Beware Mosque 'Guide' Scams
city_tips.content: Near the Blue Mosque, be wary of friendly strangers who offer to guide you through the mosque and its surrounds - it is usually a scam.
city_tips.evidence: beware of smiling, friendly chaps who offer immediately to be your de-facto guide through the mosque and its surrounds

city_tips.title: Avoid Nightclub Drink Scams
city_tips.content: High-drink-price scams occur at so-called night-clubs in Aksaray, Beyazit and Taksim that charge inflated bills off a replica menu.
city_tips.evidence: High-drink price scams encountered in so-called night-clubs mostly located in Aksaray, Beyazit and Taksim areas. These clubs usually charge overpriced bills, based on a replica of the original menu
